architectureInvariants: financial computation and persistence execute in browser Web Workers and IndexedDB
one Worker invocation performs at most one SEC upstream fetch and streams the body without normalization
D1 stores only compact public catalog/version metadata and never user financial payloads
no paid fallback, automatic upgrade or hidden service substitution is permitted
quota exhaustion preserves the last valid local snapshot and returns explicit Problem Details

serviceBudgets.expectedVolume: <500 deployed assets, all target assets <5 MiB, <=20 builds/month, one project
serviceBudgets.resourceBudget: 500/20000 files, 5/25 MiB maximum asset and 20/500 builds per month
serviceBudgets.safetyMargin: at least 80% asset-size, 97.5% file-count and 96% build headroom
serviceBudgets.limitBehavior: deployment fails closed before upload when artifact scan exceeds budget
serviceBudgets.cacheStrategy: immutable hashed assets with long browser/CDN cache; HTML no-cache revalidation
serviceBudgets.rateLimiting: not applicable to static asset delivery; deployment cadence <=20/month
serviceBudgets.freeAlternative: reduce/split assets and continue on Pages Free

serviceBudgets.reason: read-only same-origin SEC gateway with host allowlist and security headers
serviceBudgets.expectedVolume: <=2000 requests/day; personal-use target p95 <=4 ms CPU and one upstream subrequest
serviceBudgets.resourceBudget: 2% daily request quota; 40% CPU; 2% subrequests; <=0.5 MiB compressed bundle
serviceBudgets.limitBehavior: 429/503 Problem Details, Retry-After, no paid fallback, local stale snapshot retained
serviceBudgets.cacheStrategy: browser/HTTP conditional requests; no server-side personal cache
serviceBudgets.batching: client groups logical refresh but invokes one upstream resource per Worker request
serviceBudgets.rateLimiting: per-client concurrency 1, SEC ceiling 10/s, FinScope backoff 1/2/4 s
serviceBudgets.controlledDegradation: disable network refresh while preserving local analysis/export
serviceBudgets.freeAlternative: manual domain button after quota reset and frozen/local evidence

serviceBudgets.reason: compact public mapping/catalog version metadata only
serviceBudgets.expectedVolume: <=50000 rows read/day, <=1000 rows written/day, <=50 MiB total, <=2 queries/invocation
serviceBudgets.resourceBudget: 1% read quota, 1% write quota, 10% account/per-db storage, 4% query count
serviceBudgets.safetyMargin: at least 90% storage and 96% per-invocation query headroom
serviceBudgets.limitBehavior: serve embedded signed catalog version and mark remote metadata stale; no user-data loss
serviceBudgets.cacheStrategy: version metadata cached in browser and immutable deployment assets
serviceBudgets.batching: prepared indexed queries and batched metadata writes during controlled publication
serviceBudgets.rateLimiting: writes restricted to publication workflow; runtime is read-mostly
serviceBudgets.controlledDegradation: fall back to embedded catalog metadata, not a paid datastore
serviceBudgets.freeAlternative: static version manifest deployed with Pages

flowBudgets.failureMode: return bounded Problem Details and retain local snapshot
stream abort at size limit; no partial persistence
skip fallback concept with explicit reason code
use embedded version and mark stale
atomic rollback and retain previous active catalog

canaryThresholds.action: stop nonessential refresh, preserve local state, surface quota warning and require next reset/manual retry

revalidationPolicy: verify official documentation before each deployment and at least quarterly; any stricter limit blocks release until budgets are redesigned
